data.name: BUNGLERS!
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to BUNGLERS!

You have a job.

It should be simple.

Unfortunately, you and your coworkers are complete bunglers.

BUNGLERS! is a chaotic 1-4 player cooperative comedy game where you and your friends are sent out to complete simple jobs for an increasingly frustrated boss.

Deliver something. Move something. Retrieve something. Clean something up.

Easy, right?

Probably not.

One wrong step can send a package flying across the room. A helpful coworker can accidentally knock you over. A perfectly good vehicle can become part of a much bigger problem. And before you know it, a five minute job has turned into a complete disaster.

Simple Jobs. Terrible Employees.

Every mission begins with a straightforward objective.

The real challenge is surviving your coworkers.

Carry objects together, drive vehicles, throw things around, squeeze through chaotic situations and deal with whatever goes wrong along the way.

Sometimes your friends will save the job.

Sometimes they will be the reason it needs saving.

Falling Down Is Part of the Job

BUNGLERS! is built around physical comedy.

Get knocked over, tumble across the floor, crash into your coworkers, drop important cargo and create chain reactions you definitely did not plan.

The funniest moments are not scripted.

They happen because somebody had one simple task and somehow made everything worse.

Work Together... Somehow

Play alone or with up to four players.

Cooperate to finish the job, help fallen coworkers, transport important objects and keep the situation under control.

Or at least try to.

There is no need to fight your friends when basic teamwork is already dangerous enough.

The Boss Is Watching

Back at headquarters, your boss is always waiting.

Take the job.

Leave the base.

Make a mess.

Come back.

Then face the consequences.

Your performance, mistakes and property damage may be the difference between a successful shift and another furious lecture from the boss.

In BUNGLERS!, expect:

Simple jobs that go horribly wrong.

Clumsy characters and ridiculous accidents.

Carrying, throwing and losing important objects.

Vehicles that probably should not be trusted to you.

Falls, collisions and spectacular tumbles.

Missions built for unpredictable moments with friends.

A very angry boss who expects far too much from you.

Do the job.

Help your coworkers.

Try not to destroy everything.

You are BUNGLERS!, after all.

data.short_description: BUNGLERS! is a chaotic 1-4 player cooperative comedy game where a team of hopeless workers attempts simple jobs that quickly turn into complete disasters. Work together, cause accidents, survive your coworkers, and somehow get the job done.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 or equivalent (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible sound card
